description: Explain a standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week; names like MON/JAN, ranges, lists, steps, ? and the @hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly/@yearly/@reboot macros) in plain English and list the next run times in an IANA timezone. Follows Vixie cron: when both day fields are restricted a day matches either one. Quartz 6/7-field and L/W/# syntax are rejected with a clear message; per-field errors are reported. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/cron-explain/

count.description: How many upcoming run times to list (0–100). Default 10.

from.description: Start searching after this instant (ISO 8601). Default: now.

hour12.description: Describe times on a 12-hour clock (9:00 AM) instead of 24-hour (09:00).

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron daemon runs in. Default: the server's (UTC).

name: cron_explain
title: Cron explain
